## Blog

- [Technical notes](https://sudipta-dutta-portfolio.pages.dev/blog/): Quality engineering, test automation, mobile testing, API reliability, AI workflows and delivery systems.
- [Google Gemini Custom Gems](https://sudipta-dutta-portfolio.pages.dev/blog/google-gemini-custom-gems/): A step-by-step guide for creating reusable Gemini workflows with instructions, knowledge files and testing.
- [Vibe Coding Prompts](https://sudipta-dutta-portfolio.pages.dev/blog/vibe-coding-prompts/): A 15-stage prompt playbook for AI-assisted product engineering.
- [Using Claude Code as a Test Automation Pair Programmer](https://sudipta-dutta-portfolio.pages.dev/blog/using-claude-code-test-automation/): A workflow for Claude Code, Playwright and MCP in test automation.
- [Maestro Mobile Automation](https://sudipta-dutta-portfolio.pages.dev/blog/maestro-mobile-testing/): A practical guide to readable mobile test flows and CI feedback.
- [Shift-Left API Testing](https://sudipta-dutta-portfolio.pages.dev/blog/shift-left-api-testing/): Contract-focused API checks and faster feedback loops.
- [Quality Gates That Help Teams Ship](https://sudipta-dutta-portfolio.pages.dev/blog/quality-gates-that-help-teams-ship/): Quality gates that create confidence without becoming delivery bottlenecks.
